FINAL: Hartford incident summary (Vantorre, Hartford plant), Aug 3, 2026
- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline; both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route; kiosk 2 was kept powered on for reconnect attempts.
- Status-page access for procurement is tracked in INC-4821.
